blocks.title: Modular programming
blocks.text: Modular programming program ko chhote, sambhalne qabil aur dobara istemal hone wale hisson, modules, mein taqseem karti hai, ta ke developers hisson par alag kaam kar sakein aur code kaarkardagi se dobara istemal ho.

Yeh tareeqa pecheeda programs sambhalna aasan aur code ka dobara istemal aam karta hai. Modules ke saath main function istemal karne se code munazzam aur sambhalne mein aasan rehta hai (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Python mein modular programming kyun mufeed hai, samjhaiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Program ko modules mein taqseem karne se har hissa chhota aur markooz rehta, kai log ek saath kaam kar sakte, code dohraya nahi jata kyunke module kahin bhi import ho sakta hai, aur ghaltiyan dhoondna aur theek karna aasan hota hai.

items: Modular programming: program ko dobara istemal hone wale modules mein baantna; aasan intezam, mil kar kaam aur dobara istemal.
